summary: This Form 6-K filed by GSK plc on July 16, 2026 reports routine PDMR share transactions, specifically the acquisition of American Depositary Shares (ADSs) by multiple executives through dividend reinvestment. The transactions occurred on July 10 and July 14, 2026, with prices between $51.6696 and $52.4700 per ADS. Volumes are small (approx. 159 to 660 shares per trade). This is a standard disclosure of insider trading activity, not a special situation event. No special situation event is present; thus categorized as None.
